title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: More Accurate or More Efficient? Evaluating Locally Deployed Compact Open-Weight Language Models for Mathematical Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models are increasingly deployed on local hardware for privacy, cost, and accessibility reasons. Yet many evaluations emphasize accuracy while fewer quantify local runtime and energy, characterize failure modes, or apply paired statistical comparisons under controlled conditions. This paper presents a controlled, documented procedure for evaluating locally hosted LLMs on mathematical reasoning. It combines fixed inference settings, hierarchical answer extraction and verification, explicit failure-mode classification, and per-question resource measurement, and reports accuracy with paired significance tests and effect sizes. We demonstrate it in a preliminary study of three compact open-weight models under five billion parameters, Gemma3:4b (Google), Phi3:3.8b (Microsoft), and Qwen3:4b (Alibaba), across datasets spanning Grade 8 Math, Calculus I, and Advanced Probability and Statistics. All models ran through the same local inference server on one workstation, using a shared prompt template, controlled settings, and a matched question set per dataset. No single model dominates. Qwen3:4b is most accurate on two datasets and Gemma3:4b on Calculus I, yet Gemma3:4b returns roughly three times more correct answers per watt-hour than Qwen3:4b on every dataset while generating far fewer output tokens; Qwen3:4b requires substantially more generation time, energy, and output per question. Phi3:3.8b is substantially less accurate on all three datasets; its low extraction-failure rate indicates incorrect answers rather than unparsed output, though we caveat possible prompt-format effects. These preliminary findings indicate that accuracy alone is an insufficient basis for selecting a local model.
items.summary_zh: 对三款 50 亿参数以下本地开源权重模型进行数学推理的受控评测，同时比较正确率、能耗、运行时间与错误类型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它以配对统计检验和逐题资源测量表明，本地数学推理模型的选择不能只看正确率。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型因隐私、成本和可及性原因正日益部署在本地硬件上。然而，许多评测侧重准确率，较少在受控条件下量化本地运行时间和能耗、刻画失败模式，或采用配对统计比较。本文提出一套有文档记录的受控流程，用于评估本地托管 LLM 的数学推理能力。该流程结合固定推理设置、分级答案提取与验证、明确的失败模式分类和逐题资源测量，并报告带有配对显著性检验和效应量的准确率。我们在一项初步研究中展示了该流程：针对三款参数量低于 50 亿的紧凑开源权重模型 Gemma3:4b（Google）、Phi3:3.8b（Microsoft）和 Qwen3:4b（Alibaba），在涵盖 Grade 8 Math、Calculus I 和 Advanced Probability and Statistics 的数据集上进行评测。所有模型都通过同一台工作站上的同一台本地推理服务器运行，使用共享提示模板、受控设置以及每个数据集配对的问题集。没有任何一个模型在所有方面占优。Qwen3:4b 在两个数据集上最准确，Gemma3:4b 则在 Calculus I 上最准确；但在每个数据集上，Gemma3:4b 每瓦时返回的正确答案数都约为 Qwen3:4b 的三倍，同时生成的输出 token 少得多；Qwen3:4b 每题需要显著更多的生成时间、能耗和输出。Phi3:3.8b 在全部三个数据集上的准确率都显著较低；其较低的提取失败率表明问题在于答案错误而非输出无法解析，不过我们也提示可能存在提示格式效应。这些初步发现表明，仅凭准确率不足以作为选择本地模型的依据。
items.author_line: Orion Powers, Daniella Seum, Khaled Slhoub

items.title: Lexical Perturbations Disrupt LLM Reasoning: An Empirical Study of Attention Diversion
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, but their robustness to realistic lexical corruption remains poorly understood. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models and frontier models across four reasoning benchmarks under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. Character-level perturbations substantially degrade accuracy, especially on multi-step reasoning tasks, while filler insertion has little effect. We trace this asymmetry to Attention Diversion: lexical corruption fragments subword tokenization, and the resulting fragments attract disproportionate attention mass, concentrated in middle and final transformer layers. Length-matched controls confirm that fragmentation, not prompt length, drives the loss. A factorial intervention then shows why the damage is hard to undo: fragmentation corrupts token content and attention allocation together, and the two are coupled. Restoring clean attention while the content remains corrupted is actively harmful, restoring content alone is insufficient, and only restoring both recovers a substantial share of the gap. This coupling explains why inference-time strategies, including chain-of-thought prompting, spell-checking, self-repair, and stronger repair models, fail to consistently recover performance: each addresses one channel at a time. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Jiaqian-Janelle/Attention-Diversion
items.summary_zh: 研究在四个推理基准上测试词汇扰动，发现字符级噪声会显著削弱多步推理，并用注意力干预分析其机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把推理鲁棒性的下降归因于可检验的 token 化与注意力变化，而非只报告性能下降。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）已展现出较强的推理性能，但其面对真实词汇损坏时的鲁棒性仍知之甚少。我们在键盘噪声、字符交换和填充词插入条件下，跨四个推理基准评估四个开源权重指令微调模型和前沿模型。字符级扰动会显著降低准确率，尤其是在多步推理任务中，而填充词插入几乎没有影响。我们将这种不对称性归因于 Attention Diversion：词汇损坏会打碎子词 token 化，所得片段会吸引不成比例的注意力质量，且主要集中于 Transformer 的中间层和末端层。长度匹配的对照确认，导致性能损失的是片段化而非提示长度。随后的一项析因干预解释了这种损伤为何难以消除：片段化会同时破坏 token 内容和注意力分配，并且二者相互耦合。当内容仍然损坏时恢复干净注意力反而有害；仅恢复内容也不足够；只有同时恢复两者才能挽回相当一部分差距。这种耦合解释了为何推理时策略，包括 chain-of-thought 提示、拼写检查、自我修复和更强的修复模型，无法稳定恢复性能：它们每次只处理一个通道。代码和数据可见于 https://github.com/Jiaqian-Janelle/Attention-Diversion
items.author_line: Jiaqian Zhu, Yang Zhang, Junhua Ding, Xiaowei Yu

items.title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO
items.summary_zh: SRPO 通过反思已完成轨迹生成修补信息，并把稀疏终局监督转为 token 级训练信号；摘要报告其在 AIME'24 和多项长程任务上的结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AIME'24 的明确分数、训练 FLOPs 比较和跨任务结果，使其数学推理改进主张可被后续复现检验。
items.abstract_zh: 自我反思是人类学习中用于信用分配的强大机制，能够把稀疏的结果反馈转化为可执行的指导。然而，它在大语言模型（LLMs）后训练中的潜力仍未被充分探索。我们提出 Self-Reflective Policy Optimization（SRPO），一个将这一能力内化的框架。SRPO 使 LLM 能够分析自身已完成的轨迹，将错误综合为简洁的“reflection patches”，并在学生模型的 on-policy rollout 上使用以反思为条件的教师评分，作为稠密的 token 级训练信号。该过程无需外部评论器、单独的奖励模型或更大的教师模型，便能有效地把稀疏的终局监督转化为稠密的 token 级学习信号。我们证明 SRPO 以出色的数据效率，在数学推理和长程智能体基准上取得了最先进性能。以 Qwen3-8B 为基础模型，SRPO 仅使用扩展监督微调所需训练 FLOPs 的 8%（0.08 倍），就在 AIME'24 上达到 73.3%；同时还显著提高了 WebShop（64.7%）、ALFWorld（76.8%）和 SWE-Bench-Lite（31.2%）的成功率。代码可见于 https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO
items.author_line: Jialong Liu, Yuling Shi, Ning Yang, Xiaodong Gu, Zuchao Li

items.title: Beyond Factual Knowledge: Benchmarking and Learning Step-Level Procedural Rule Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) excel at text understanding and generation, yet still struggle to reliably understand and apply externally provided procedural rules at scale. To evaluate this capability, we introduce RuleWorld, a large-scale benchmark that reformulates rules as globally reusable abstract units rather than instance-specific facts. In RuleWorld, several scenarios, including single-rule, parallel multi-rule, and multi-hop reasoning, are settled for comprehensive evaluation. We further propose DynaRule, an end-to-end framework that injects the given rules into the KV cache and turns retrieval into an internal, learnable, step-wise process. Specifically, DynaRule employs Stacked Step-Level Attention Training with a special token to enable dynamic rule re-attention and updating during inference. In this way, the model can re-attend to the most relevant rules at each step, dynamically replacing outdated ones to support more stable multi-step reasoning. Experiments on RuleWorld show that existing LLMs face challenges under large rule pools, while DynaRule improves average QA accuracy by up to 19 points and achieves over 85% Recall@1 at 10K rules, outperforming strong baselines by large margins. We make our code and dataset available here: https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/Beyond-Factual-Knowledge.
items.summary_zh: RuleWorld 将程序规则组织为可复用的抽象单元，用于评测单规则、并行多规则和多跳推理；DynaRule 以逐步注意力处理大规则池。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作提供公开基准、数据集与代码，并报告规则检索和问答结果，便于核查模型是否真正按规则推理。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）擅长文本理解和生成，却仍难以可靠地大规模理解并应用外部提供的程序规则。为评估这一能力，我们提出 RuleWorld，一个大规模基准；它将规则重构为可全局复用的抽象单元，而非特定实例的事实。RuleWorld 设置了单规则、并行多规则和多跳推理等多种情景，以开展全面评估。我们进一步提出 DynaRule，一个端到端框架：它将给定规则注入 KV cache，并把检索转化为内部的、可学习的逐步过程。具体而言，DynaRule 使用带有特殊 token 的 Stacked Step-Level Attention Training，使模型能够在推理期间对规则进行动态的再注意和更新。如此，模型可在每一步重新关注最相关的规则，动态替换过时规则，以支持更稳定的多步推理。RuleWorld 上的实验表明，现有 LLM 在大型规则池中面临挑战，而 DynaRule 可将平均问答准确率提高最多 19 个点，并在 1 万条规则下达到超过 85% 的 Recall@1，大幅超过强基线。我们的代码和数据集公开于：https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/Beyond-Factual-Knowledge。
items.author_line: Bohan Yu, Pengfei Cao, Chen Han, Chenxi Zhou, Zhiheng Zhang, Zhiyang Xie, Wenhao Teng, Xiangwen Liao, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu

items.title: Decoupled Physical Modeling and Execution for Physics Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Physics reasoning requires constructing a consistent model of the underlying physical system rather than relying solely on symbolic or formula-based manipulation. Although large language models have shown strong ability in solving math and coding problems, they still struggle with physics problems, as these problems entangle the physical modeling process with mathematical calculations. Humans approach physics by first building a representation of the system before performing calculations. Inspired by this, we introduce a unified framework that distills intermediate representations that explicitly encode the physical modeling process and adopt a two-stage post-training strategy, where supervised fine-tuning establishes structured modeling, and reinforcement learning with rubric-based feedback improves the quality of the modeling process. Experiments on multiple multimodal physics benchmarks show that our approach leads to consistent improvements in reasoning performance across different models and datasets. On PhysReason, PhyX and SeePhys benchmarks, physical modeling output performs GRPO by an average ~3%, showing that explicit physical modeling is an efficient strategy of improving physics reasoning for small LLMs.
items.summary_zh: 该方法先显式构建物理系统表征，再进行计算，并在多个多模态物理基准上比较结构化建模与直接推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 物理建模与计算被分别评测，有助于检验模型改进是否来自更一致的问题表征。
items.abstract_zh: 物理推理要求构建对底层物理系统一致的模型，而非仅依赖符号或公式操作。尽管大语言模型已展现出解决数学和编程问题的强大能力，它们在物理问题上仍然困难重重，因为这些问题把物理建模过程与数学计算纠缠在一起。人类处理物理问题时会先构建系统表征，再进行计算。受此启发，我们引入一个统一框架：蒸馏出显式编码物理建模过程的中间表征，并采用两阶段后训练策略，其中监督微调用于建立结构化建模，采用 rubric 反馈的强化学习用于提高建模过程的质量。在多个多模态物理基准上的实验显示，我们的方法在不同模型和数据集上持续提升推理性能。在 PhysReason、PhyX 和 SeePhys 基准上，物理建模输出平均比 GRPO 高约 3%，表明显式物理建模是提升小型 LLM 物理推理的一种高效策略。
items.author_line: Ye Zhang, Xuehang Guo, Rui Pan, Pengfei Yu, Denghui Zhang, Manling Li, Qingyun Wang

items.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models can produce fluent reasoning traces whose local semantic errors propagate to an incorrect conclusion, while unconstrained self-correction may preserve, amplify, or introduce errors. Existing diffusion language models provide iterative refinement, but usually define noise as token masking or replacement rather than as errors in the reasoning process. We present Semantic Reasoning Denoising (SRD), an operatorized Markov denoising method for natural-language reasoning trajectories. SRD represents semantic noise with executable error operators that describe the error type, its location, and the corrupted and repaired propositions. Composing these operators constructs progressively noisier states. During training, the model learns to identify the semantic noise active in the current trajectory and to reconstruct the paired adjacent lower-noise state. During inference, noise-level-aware denoising repeatedly predicts an inverse operator and checks whether it is applicable, so each executed update makes a localized move toward a stable trajectory. Across six in-domain benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, knowledge, and commonsense, SRD improves the strongest same backbone baseline by 3.2 points on average. On seven cross-dataset transfer targets, it remains competitive with Llama-3-8B-Instruct and improves the strongest Qwen3-8B baseline average by 2.9 points. Analyses of noise sources, objectives, and denoising depth further show that structured semantic-noise prediction and iterative operator execution are central to the improvement.
items.summary_zh: SRD 把推理轨迹中的语义错误表示为可执行算子，并通过逐步去噪与适用性检查修正局部错误。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它覆盖数学在内的多类基准，并以算子执行和消融分析检验推理修正机制。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型可以生成流畅的推理轨迹，但其中的局部语义错误会传播并导致错误结论，而无约束的自我修正可能保留、放大或引入错误。现有扩散语言模型能够进行迭代细化，但通常把噪声定义为 token 掩蔽或替换，而非推理过程中的错误。我们提出 Semantic Reasoning Denoising（SRD），一种用于自然语言推理轨迹的算子化 Markov 去噪方法。SRD 使用可执行错误算子表示语义噪声；这些算子描述错误类型、位置以及被破坏和被修复的命题。组合这些算子即可构造逐渐更嘈杂的状态。训练时，模型学习识别当前轨迹中活跃的语义噪声，并重建与之配对的相邻较低噪声状态。推理时，具备噪声级别感知的去噪会反复预测逆算子并检查其是否适用，因此每次执行的更新都会朝向稳定轨迹作局部移动。在涵盖数学、代码、知识和常识的六个域内基准上，SRD 相比最强的同骨干基线平均提高 3.2 个点。在七个跨数据集迁移目标上，它与 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 保持竞争力，并将最强 Qwen3-8B 基线的平均成绩提高 2.9 个点。对噪声来源、目标函数和去噪深度的分析还表明，结构化语义噪声预测和迭代算子执行是性能提升的核心。

items.title: The Chase Is the Curriculum, the Capture Anchors the Credit: Pursuit-Evasion Self-Play for Zero-Data LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the dominant recipe for improving large language model reasoning, yet it presumes large human-curated task collections. Zero-data self-play removes this dependency, but existing methods vet learnability only by probing candidates and rejecting post hoc, never learning where along an environment's difficulty axis to place a task, and credit the solver with sparse terminal rewards alone. We recast zero-data self-play as a pursuit-evasion game: in LURE, an LLM evader positions tasks along each environment's difficulty axis to stay one step ahead of a planner-executor pursuer that hunts it down through verifiable interaction. The evader is trained on a capture-frontier reward that peaks when the solver captures it on exactly half of its rollouts, turning barely catchable into a learned positioning strategy rather than a hand-tuned rejection band. The pursuer earns capture-anchored dense process credit, in which monotone verifier progress is group-normalized jointly with the terminal capture under a round-anchored KL that keeps the co-evolution stable. Across three verifiable reasoning environments and three backbone families, LURE outperforms advanced baselines under unified/specialist settings, while the unified model attains stronger aggregate OOD zero-shot accuracy than all trained baselines across nine held-out benchmarks from three task families.
items.summary_zh: LURE 将零数据自博弈构造成追逃过程，以可验证交互的进展信号训练生成任务与求解任务的模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法在可验证推理环境和留出基准上报告结果，讨论了无需人工任务集训练推理模型的可检验路径。
items.abstract_zh: 采用可验证奖励的强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的主流方案，但它以大量人工整理的任务集合为前提。零数据自博弈消除了这一依赖，但现有方法只通过探测候选任务并事后拒绝来检验可学习性，从未学习应将任务放在环境难度轴的何处；同时，它们只以稀疏的终局奖励为求解器分配信用。我们将零数据自博弈重新表述为追逃博弈：在 LURE 中，LLM 逃逸者沿每个环境的难度轴布置任务，以保持领先于通过可验证交互追捕它的规划—执行追逐者一步。逃逸者在捕获前沿奖励上训练：当求解器恰在一半 rollout 中捕获逃逸者时，该奖励达到峰值，从而将“勉强可捕获”转化为学习得到的定位策略，而非人工调节的拒绝区间。追逐者获得以捕获为参照的稠密过程信用：单调的验证器进展与终局捕获共同进行组归一化，并采用以轮次为参照的 KL，使共同演化保持稳定。在三个可验证推理环境和三个骨干模型家族上，LURE 在统一模型和专用模型设置下均优于先进基线；统一模型在来自三个任务家族的九个留出基准上取得了比所有已训练基线更强的汇总 OOD 零样本准确率。
items.author_line: Jing Yu, Shengchao Chen, Yiyun Tan

items.title: From Solver Feedback to Faithful Plans: Multi-Role Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Planning
items.abstract_or_text: Reliable planning requires converting natural-language instructions into executable symbolic specifications, yet large language models remain brittle without costly PDDL annotations and may exploit solver success in semantically unfaithful ways. We study how to learn faithful natural-language-to-PDDL formalization using only solver feedback, without human-written demonstrations. We propose a solvergrounded multi-role reinforcement learning framework where a single language model acts as an Actor, Judge, and Editor for generation, verification, and repair. The Actor proposes PDDL specifications, the Judge provides a solver-calibrated quality signal, and the Editor performs bounded diagnostic-conditioned refinement. On PlanBench, our method improves average success from 35.5% for LLM+P to 70.8%, achieves 66.3% faithful success, and reduces semantic drift to 6.4%. These results show that organizing solver feedback into generation, verification, and repair roles enables more scalable and faithful annotation-free symbolic planning
items.summary_zh: 该工作以求解器反馈训练模型把自然语言转写为 PDDL，并以生成、验证和修复三个角色评测语义忠实度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: PDDL 可执行性和忠实成功率将形式化结果与自然语言含义同时纳入检验，减少只满足求解器却偏离任务语义的情况。
items.abstract_zh: 可靠规划需要把自然语言指令转换为可执行的符号规范，但在没有高成本 PDDL 标注时，大语言模型仍然脆弱，并且可能通过语义上不忠实的方式利用求解器成功。我们研究如何仅使用求解器反馈学习忠实的自然语言到 PDDL 形式化，而不使用人工编写的示例。我们提出一个以求解器为基础的多角色强化学习框架，其中单个语言模型担任 Actor、Judge 和 Editor，分别进行生成、验证和修复。Actor 提出 PDDL 规范，Judge 提供经求解器校准的质量信号，Editor 进行受限的、由诊断条件驱动的细化。在 PlanBench 上，我们的方法将 LLM+P 的平均成功率从 35.5% 提升至 70.8%，达到 66.3% 的忠实成功率，并将语义漂移降至 6.4%。这些结果表明，将求解器反馈组织为生成、验证和修复角色，能够实现更可扩展且更忠实的无标注符号规划。
items.author_line: Chenghao Zhang, Yikai Mao, Shanqi Liu, Haoyu Gao, SaiSai Hu, Dan Roth

review.note: 本轮保留 8 项公开 arXiv 预印本；它们的摘要明确说明了推理任务、评测设置、可执行验证或可量化结果。
